system.description:
• Effect: You may found a chapter house (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 1d6 lay brothers and one 1st-level Paladin of your god join it. While you hold it, once per month you may call on your god's Divine Will: every creature that can hear your voice makes a Will save against your Class Save DC or takes up a cause you name, as under a Geas, for days equal to your Paladin level.
  • Divine Will does not affect inherently evil creatures or player characters
